text:
Permenent abandonment operations to sever, pull and remove casings. (All other abandonment work previously conducted.)

#6: All casing (7", 10-3/4" & 16") cut on 2/20/14 with cutting tool to 20' BML. Total 75.5' - 5250 lbs. 

Cut 36" drive pipe on 2/21/14 with cutting tool (ICT) to 16' BML. Length 70.2' - 32,150 lbs.

Additional TA work was completed on 03/20/2011.  The 7-5/8" was cut with a casing cutter at 285' BML on 03/05/2011.  From 09/03/09 to 09/04/09, the 26" was cut @ 19' BML and the 10-3/4" was cut @ 14' BML during wedding cake operations on the platform to remove obstructions to the wellbore.

Stone Energy has successfully performed zone change operations on the PL 23 OCS-G 01238, Well No. D001 to produce the "W Sand".  Operations began on May 11, 2008 and were completed on June 8, 2008.  The previous producing interval in the well the "X-2 Sand" was isolated by setting an EZSV @ 16000', dumping 10' cement on top and setting a CIBP 15980'.  The "W Sand" was perforated 15924' - 15944' for production.

Well is T/A. e-well will not let me make the reservior name change

Please submit a correction report regarding the sand. If BRA3 is correct, simply change it on the wellbore. Correction report was submitted last week.

Temporarily abandon VK 826 A013. The Chris K was squeezed and abandoned with coil tubing prior to temporary abandonment operations.
Tubing was cut at 10,165' MD and pulled from the well. 
Release mudline packer and pull downhole equipment. Note, could not get down and found large amounts of paraffin when tool string was recovered. Went to secondary release mechanism for mudline packer.
Set bridge plug and set 200' cement plug on top of CIBP, then used a retrievable packer to isolate leak. See attached verbal approval for reference.
POH with retrievable packer and set cement retainer at 5,600' MD, pump 19 bbls of cement and squeeze casing leak at 5,623' MD-5,639' MD. Pressure test casing to 1500 psi for 15 minutes.
Spot 50' cement plug on top of retainer to leave TOC at 5,550' MD. Pressure test casing to 1500 psi for 15 minutes.
Set cement retainer w/ TCP at 4,384' MD, perforate 9 5/8" casing from 4,500'-4,504'. 9 5/8" x 13 3/8" annulus postive and negative tested. 50' cement on top of cement retainer, TOC at 4,334' MD. Test casing and plug to 1500 psi.
Set cement retainer w/ TCP at 2,835' MD, 9 5/8" and 13 5/8" casing perforated from 2,950'-2,954' MD. 13 3/8" x 20" annulus postive and negative tested. Cement plug on top of retainer, TOC 2,285' MD.

Zone change operations have been completed on the EC 36 Well A-1 to produce the "Cris I M-7" Sd (S02). The "Cris I M-8" Sd (S01) existing perfs of 9,934'-9,945' MD (9,367'-9,378' TVD) were isolated by setting a MRBP at 9,891' RKB + 10' cmt (ETOC 9,881' RKB); pressure tested to 1050 psi. The "Cris I M-7" Sd was open to production by shifting sliding sleeves at 9,754' & 9,772' MD open. Operations began 01/09/2015 and ended 01/18/2015.

Plugged back to Sidetrack complete - NOTE: Suspect dehydrated drilling mud from 9-5/8" x 13-3/8" casing annulus was pushed to bottom.  Available pump unable to circulate at high enough rate to remove mud f/wellbore.  Decision made to R/D.  Plan to clean wellbore and set CIBP in 13-3/8" with drilling rig at later date

GasLift Modification - Pulled and placed packoff assembly at 1357'- 1420' MD, installed live GLVs and set FXE at 442' MD.

Please note contingency steps 13-15 in procedure were omitted from the operation.

Operations Completed 09/18/2016

Stone has successfully performed a zone change operation on the PL 23 OCS G-01238, Well No. C-001ST to produce the CP27 Sand.  Operations began on May 28, 2007 and were completed on June 3, 2007. The previous producing interval in the well, the CP28 Sand was isolated by setting a Posi-set Plug @ 15080' & dumping 32' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 15048'.  The 5" liner was perforated @ 14912' - 14954' for production.

Completed as a single stacked gravel packed completion in the Lower KJ/KK Sand with an unperforated selective in the LP Sand.  The Lower KJ/KK Sand will only be produced at this time.  A zone change could be submitted at a later date to commingle the sands.

Also please note:  The KJ/KK Sand is hooked up and ready to flow.  Due to Hurricane Ike, the well is temporarily shut-in.

Used HWOU to conduct casing pressure remediation operations.  SCP remediated by installing two isolation packer assemblies and the well was returned to production on 06/12/2018.
No change to the producing zone.

ERT has complete operations on the WC 215, OCS-G 04087, Well A16BP. The wellbore was spud on 07-21-07 and drilled to a TD of 12300' MD / 11136' TVD on 07-30-07.  The well was successfuly completed as a single, gravel packed, oil completion in the "Big 2 1-B" Sand. Completion operations were completed on 08-23-07.

Permanent Abandonment. Received a departure from 250.1716(a),which states that all casing must be removed 15' BML. All remaining casings were cut @ 200' BWL (450' AML). The conductors and platform are a reef in place.

Anadarko received approval for a 14 day temporary zone change/test for EB 646 SS007 ST01. The DS-1 FB A sand was temporarily isolated and only the DS-1 FB A sand was produced temporarily. 

The isolation resulted in a loss of oil and an increase in water after production. Therefore the test was ended early and the well was returned to the pre-test configuration with both the DS-1 FB A and DP-1 FB A open. Both the district and region were notified.

*Per the approved APM comments Anadarko was required to return the wellbore to the commingled DP-1/DS-1 completion at the end of the test period unless written permission was granted by both the district and the region to do otherwise. This was also discussed with Mark Osterman prior to sleeve shift back to the commingled configuration.

ERT has completed permanent abandonment operations of the EC 364 A01.  A derrick barge was moved on location and as part of the operations to remove the EC 364 A platform, the remaining casing strings of the EC 364 A01 well, the 36" drive pipe & 20" conductor csg were cut and pulled 16' BML.  Operations started and were completed on 11-04-09.

Stone Energy Corporation has successfully completed operations on the MC 109 Well No. A012ST01 to install live gas lift valves in the well to convert to a gas lift oil well. Operations began 01/08/2012 and ended 01/31/2012.

Badger was unable to pull the conductor casing and drive pipe free from the wellbore at this time; therefore, this well remains in TA status.  At the time of platform removal, Badger will pull the remaining casings at a minimum of 15' BML.

The well was temporarily abandoned through the surface plug as of 05/10/2025; however, eWell recognizes the zonal isolation date as the temporary abandonment date from a previous EOR and cannot be changed.

Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-16 well to install a subsurface safety PB insert valve in the X-nipple at 471' MD to convert the operation of the downhole safety valve to subsea control. This has allowed for production to be restored from the well. Operations began and ended on 04/27/2011.

See attached file, Current Wellbore Schematic for details.

Stone Energy has completed operations on the ST 164 Well C-10 to install a PB safety valve insert in lieu of a SCSSV due to the inability to re-establish control line integrity. The PB safety valve & X lock were set in the 2.813" X profile at 810' MD. Operations started 04/27/2012 and ended 04/28/2012.
